description.value: Layla Shawarma is a Lebanese fast-food restaurant on Quadra Street in Victoria, built around a 50-year-old family recipe originating from the village of Layla in Lebanon. The menu spans traditional shawarma wraps, rice and salad bowls, falafel, hand-stretched flatbreads, and fusion items like shawarma poutine and donairs. Halal meats are used throughout, and organic cold-pressed olive oil from Lebanon is a signature ingredient.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands at 62m; stands at 65m; stands at 65m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at laylashawarma.com is live and active, confirming the business is open with a full online menu and 'Order Now' / 'Add to cart' functionality, supporting takeout as a confirmed service. The menu lists falafel, tabbouli, fattoush, flatbreads, garlic potatoes, and avocado cocktail, confirming multiple vegetarian options. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM tags or on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active fast-food restaurant on a main Victoria street with a live website and full menu — a straightforward include for the directory.
